Always handle quota exhaustion mid-transfer\n204\t * even if pre-flight checks pass.\n205\t *\n206\t * @returns Storage quota estimate or null if not supported\n207\t */\n208\texport async function estimateStorageQuota(): Promise<StorageQuotaEstimate | null> {\n209\t  try {\n210\t    if (!navigator.storage || !navigator.storage.estimate) {\n211\t      console.warn('[Storage] navigator.storage.estimate() not supported');\n212\t      return null;\n213\t    }\n214\t\n215\t    const estimate = await navigator.storage.estimate();\n216\t\n217\t    if (!estimate || estimate.quota == null || estimate.usage == null) {\n218\t      console.warn('[Storage] Invalid storage estimate:', estimate);\n219\t      return null;\n220\t    }\n221\t\n222\t    const quota = estimate.quota;\n223\t    const usage = estimate.usage;\n224\t    const available = quota - usage;\n225\t\n226\t    return {\n227\t      quota,\n228\t      usage,\n229\t      available,\n230\t    };\n231\t  } catch (error) {\n232\t    console.error('[Storage] Failed to estimate storage quota:', error);\n233\t    return null;\n234\t  }\n235\t}\n236\t\n237\t/**\n238\t * Calculate compression staging buffer for file transfer (bf-4d6).\n239\t *\n240\t * During compression and encoding, the sender needs temporary working space.\n241\t * This accounts for:\n242\t * - Compressed data staging\n243\t * - Block encoding buffers\n244\t * - Fountain code matrix storage (I6a: 1 MB working set)\n245\t * - Temporary artifacts during transfer\n246\t *\n247\t * **Formula:** staging = fileSize * 0.15 + 10 MB\n248\t * - 15% overhead for compression staging (conservative estimate)\n249\t * - 10 MB fixed buffer for codec working sets\n250\t *\n251\t * @param fileSize - Size of the file to transfer in bytes\n252\t * @returns Required staging buffer in bytes\n253\t */\n254\texport function calculateCompressionStagingBuffer(fileSize: number): number {\n255\t  const COMPRESSION_OVERHEAD = 0.15; // 15% overhead for compression staging\n256\t  const CODEC_BUFFER = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10 MB fixed codec buffer\n257\t\n258\t  return Math.ceil(fileSize * COMPRESSION_OVERHEAD) + CODEC_BUFFER;\n259\t}\n260\t\n261\t/**\n262\t * Check if there's enough storage capacity for a file transfer (bf-4d6 F1).\n263\t *\n264\t * **Pre-flight validation:** Call this BEFORE accepting a file to avoid\n265\t * discovering quota exhaustion hours into a transfer.\n266\t *\n267\t * **Safety margin:** Multiplies required space by 1.5 to account for:\n268\t * - OPFS filesystem overhead\n269\t * - Metadata storage\n270\t * - Quota estimate inaccuracies (especially Safari)\n271\t * - Platform-specific quota variations\n272\t *\n273\t * @param fileSize - Size of the file to transfer in bytes\n274\t * @param additionalSpace - Optional additional space to reserve in bytes\n275\t * @returns Storage capacity check result\n276\t */\n277\texport async function checkStorageCapacity(\n278\t  fileSize: number,\n279\t  additionalSpace: number = 0\n280\t): Promise<StorageCapacityResult> {\n281\t  // Default to assuming capacity if estimate unavailable (don't block on unsupported platforms)\n282\t  const estimate = await estimateStorageQuota();\n283\t\n284\t  if (!estimate) {\n285\t    console.warn('[Storage] Unable to estimate quota, proceeding with caution');\n286\t    return {\n287\t      hasCapacity: true, // Optimistic default - let the transfer attempt\n288\t      estimate: {\n289\t        quota: 0,\n290\t        usage: 0,\n291\t        available: 0,\n292\t      },\n293\t      requiredSpace: fileSize + additionalSpace,\n294\t      availableSpace: 0,\n295\t    };\n296\t  }\n297\t\n298\t  // Calculate required space with staging buffer and safety margin\n299\t  const stagingBuffer = calculateCompressionStagingBuffer(fileSize);\n300\t  const baseRequired = fileSize + stagingBuffer + additionalSpace;\n301\t  const SAFETY_MARGIN = 1.5; // 50% safety margin for quota estimate inaccuracies\n302\t  const requiredSpace = Math.ceil(baseRequired * SAFETY_MARGIN);\n303\t\n304\t  const hasCapacity = estimate.available >= requiredSpace;\n305\t\n306\t  if (!hasCapacity) {\n307\t    const shortfall = requiredSpace - estimate.available;\n308\t    const error = `Insufficient storage capacity. Required: ${formatBytes(requiredSpace)}, Available: ${formatBytes(estimate.available)}, Shortfall: ${formatBytes(shortfall)}`;\n309\t\n310\t    console.warn('[Storage] Capacity check failed:', error);\n311\t\n312\t    return {\n313\t      hasCapacity: false,\n314\t      estimate,\n315\t      requiredSpace,\n316\t      availableSpace: estimate.available,\n317\t      error,\n318\t    };\n319\t  }\n320\t\n321\t  console.log('[Storage] Capacity check passed:', {\n322\t    required: formatBytes(requiredSpace),\n323\t    available: formatBytes(estimate.available),\n324\t    margin: formatBytes(estimate.available - requiredSpace),\n325\t  });\n326\t\n327\t  return {\n328\t    hasCapacity: true,\n329\t    estimate,\n330\t    requiredSpace,\n331\t    availableSpace: estimate.available,\n332\t  };\n333\t}\n334\t\n335\t/**\n336\t * Format bytes as human-readable string (e.g., \"1.5 GB\").\n337\t */\n338\tfunction formatBytes(bytes: number): string {\n339\t  const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];\n340\t  let size = bytes;\n341\t  let unitIndex = 0;\n342\t\n343\t  while (size >= 1024 && unitIndex < units.length - 1) {\n344\t    size /= 1024;\n345\t    unitIndex++;\n346\t  }\n347\t\n348\t  return `${size.toFixed(unitIndex === 0 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[unitIndex]}`;\n349\t}\n350\t\n351\t/**\n352\t * OPFS-based storage manager implementation.\n353\t {"type":"assistant","message":{"id":"msg_20260804150329f6ae323c605047df","type":"message","role":"assistant","model":"glm-4.7","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"call_b0cc4ef5be4c4ee4ae156714","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/coding/screenferry/notes/bf-3zoz4-conflict-check-pattern.md","content":"# Conflict Check Pattern Reference\n\n**Bead:** bf-3zoz4\n**Reference Implementation:** `src/core/frame/beacon.ts` (lines 610-629)\n**Error Codes:** `src/core/errors/error-codes.ts`\n**Test Coverage:** `test/bf-4bi6-compression-resume-conflict.test.ts`\n\n## Pattern Overview\n\nConflict checks are **pure validation functions** that throw errors **before any state changes** occur. They prevent unsafe combinations of flags, parameters, or configuration values that would cause silent corruption, undefined behavior, or resource leaks.\n\n## Core Pattern\n\n### 1. Error Class Definition\n\n```typescript\n// Custom error class with structured data\nexport class BeaconValidationError extends Error {\n  constructor(\n    public code: string,           // Stable error code\n    message: string,               // User-facing error message\n    public details: Record<string, unknown>  // Diagnostic metadata\n  ) {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'BeaconValidationError';\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Key properties:**\n- `code`: Stable identifier for programmatic handling\n- `message`: Clear explanation for users\n- `details`: Raw diagnostic data (flags, values, states)\n- Inherits from `Error` for standard exception handling\n\n### 2. Conflict Check Implementation\n\n```typescript\n// Location: Entry point function BEFORE any state changes\nexport function encodeBeacon(meta: BeaconMeta): Uint8Array {\n  // ===== CONFLICT CHECK ZONE =====\n  // All validation happens here, before any files/sessions are created\n\n  const compressionEnabled = (meta.flags & BeaconFlags.Compressed) !== 0;\n  const resumeDisabled = (meta.flags & BeaconFlags.ResumeDisabled) !== 0;\n\n  // Exact condition: compression enabled BUT resume not disabled\n  if (compressionEnabled && !resumeDisabled) {\n    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n      'E-COMPRESSION-RESUME-CONFLICT',           // Stable error code\n      `E-COMPRESSION-RESUME-CONFLICT: Compression cannot be enabled without disabling resume. ` +\n      `When BeaconFlags.Compressed is set, BeaconFlags.ResumeDisabled must also be set. ` +\n      `This incompatibility is required because CompressionStream offers no determinism guarantee across ` +\n      `browser restarts, making resume unsafe (see bf-17s0, bf-2w1a).`,\n      {                                        // Diagnostic metadata\n        flags: meta.flags,\n        compressionEnabled,\n        resumeDisabled\n      }\n    );\n  }\n\n  // ===== SAFE ZONE =====\n  // No state changes happen above this line\n  // Only valid configurations reach this point\n  const session = createSession(...);\n  const file = openFile(...);\n  // ... rest of initialization\n}\n```\n\n**Pattern elements:**\n1. **Check location:** At the very top of the entry function, before any state changes\n2. **Condition check:** Extract values from input parameters, test for conflict\n3. **Error code:** Stable identifier starting with `E-`\n4. **Error message:** Multi-line explanation with:\n   - What requirement was violated\n   - Which specific condition is incompatible\n   - Why it's unsafe (technical explanation)\n   - Cross-references to analysis beads\n5. **Details object:** Raw diagnostic data for debugging\n\n### 3. Test Pattern\n\n```typescript\ndescribe('Conflict detection', () => {\n  it('should throw when [condition]', () => {\n    const meta = createValidMeta();\n    // Trigger the conflict\n    meta.flags = BeaconFlags.Compressed;\n\n    expect(() => encodeBeacon(meta)).toThrow(BeaconValidationError);\n    expect(() => encodeBeacon(meta)).toThrow('E-COMPRESSION-RESUME-CONFLICT');\n  });\n\n  it('should provide clear error message', () => {\n    const meta = createValidMeta();\n    meta.flags = BeaconFlags.Compressed;\n\n    try {\n      encodeBeacon(meta);\n      expect.fail('Should have thrown BeaconValidationError');\n    } catch (error) {\n      expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(BeaconValidationError);\n      if (error instanceof BeaconValidationError) {\n        expect(error.code).toBe('E-COMPRESSION-RESUME-CONFLICT');\n        expect(error.message).toContain('Compression cannot be enabled');\n        expect(error.message).toContain('bf-17s0');\n      }\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('should include conflict details in error', () => {\n    const meta = createValidMeta();\n    meta.flags = BeaconFlags.Compressed;\n\n    try {\n      encodeBeacon(meta);\n      expect.fail('Should have thrown BeaconValidationError');\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof BeaconValidationError) {\n        expect(error.details).toBeDefined();\n        expect(error.details.flags).toBe(BeaconFlags.Compressed);\n        expect(error.details.compressionEnabled).toBe(true);\n        expect(error.details.resumeDisabled).toBe(false);\n      }\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('should allow [valid configuration]', () => {\n    const meta = createValidMeta();\n    // Valid configuration - both flags set\n    meta.flags = BeaconFlags.Compressed | BeaconFlags.ResumeDisabled;\n\n    expect(() => encodeBeacon(meta)).not.toThrow();\n  });\n\n  it('should fail before any state changes', () => {\n    const meta = createValidMeta();\n    meta.flags = BeaconFlags.Compressed; // Conflict!\n\n    // Check happens immediately, no side effects\n    expect(() => encodeBeacon(meta)).toThrow(BeaconValidationError);\n\n    // Verify input object unchanged\n    expect(meta.flags).toBe(BeaconFlags.Compressed);\n  });\n});\n```\n\n**Test coverage requirements:**\n- ✅ Conflict condition throws the error\n- ✅ Error code matches expected value\n- ✅ Error message explains the incompatibility\n- ✅ Error details include diagnostic data\n- ✅ Valid configurations don't throw\n- ✅ Check happens before state changes\n- ✅ No side effects from the check itself\n\n## Error Code Convention\n\n### Format\n\n```\nE-[CATEGORY]-[SPECIFIC-CONDITION]\n```\n\n**Examples:**\n- `E-COMPRESSION-RESUME-CONFLICT` — Incompatible flag combination\n- `E-K-OVERFLOW` — Parameter exceeds maximum supported value\n- `E-QUOTA-PREFLIGHT` — Resource constraint violation\n\n### Registration\n\nWhen adding a new error code, register it in `src/core/errors/error-codes.ts`:\n\n```typescript\n// User-facing message\nexport const ERROR_MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {\n  // ... existing codes ...\n  'E-COMPRESSION-RESUME-CONFLICT': 'Compression cannot be enabled without disabling resume.',\n  // ... add new code here ...\n};\n\n// Metadata\nexport const ERROR_METADATA: Record<string, {\n  category: string;\n  recoverable: boolean;\n  severity: ErrorSeverity;\n}> = {\n  // ... existing codes ...\n  'E-COMPRESSION-RESUME-CONFLICT': {\n    category: 'protocol',\n    recoverable: false,        // User must fix and retry\n    severity: ErrorSeverity.FATAL,\n  },\n  // ... add new code here ...\n};\n```\n\n## Safety Properties\n\n### 1. Pure Function\nThe conflict check must be a **pure function** of its inputs:\n- No side effects (no file I/O, no network calls, no state mutation)\n- Same inputs → same outputs (always throws or never throws)\n- No dependencies on external state\n\n### 2. They prevent unsafe combinations of flags, parameters, or configuration values that would cause silent corruption, undefined behavior, or resource leaks.\n\n## Core Pattern\n\n### 1. Error Class Definition\n\n```typescript\n// Custom error class with structured data\nexport class BeaconValidationError extends Error {\n  constructor(\n    public code: string,           // Stable error code\n    message: string,               // User-facing error message\n    public details: Record<string, unknown>  // Diagnostic metadata\n  ) {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'BeaconValidationError';\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Key properties:**\n- `code`: Stable identifier for programmatic handling\n- `message`: Clear explanation for users\n- `details`: Raw diagnostic data (flags, values, states)\n- Inherits from `Error` for standard exception handling\n\n### 2. Conflict Check Implementation\n\n```typescript\n// Location: Entry point function BEFORE any state changes\nexport function encodeBeacon(meta: BeaconMeta): Uint8Array {\n  // ===== CONFLICT CHECK ZONE =====\n  // All validation happens here, before any files/sessions are created\n\n  const compressionEnabled = (meta.flags & BeaconFlags.Compressed) !== 0;\n  const resumeDisabled = (meta.flags & BeaconFlags.ResumeDisabled) !== 0;\n\n  // Exact condition: compression enabled BUT resume not disabled\n  if (compressionEnabled && !resumeDisabled) {\n    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n      'E-COMPRESSION-RESUME-CONFLICT',           // Stable error code\n      `E-COMPRESSION-RESUME-CONFLICT: Compression cannot be enabled without disabling resume. ` +\n      `When BeaconFlags.Compressed is set, BeaconFlags.ResumeDisabled must also be set. ` +\n      `This incompatibility is required because CompressionStream offers no determinism guarantee across ` +\n      `browser restarts, making resume unsafe (see bf-17s0, bf-2w1a).`,\n      {                                        // Diagnostic metadata\n        flags: meta.flags,\n        compressionEnabled,\n        resumeDisabled\n      }\n    );\n  }\n\n  // ===== SAFE ZONE =====\n  // No state changes happen above this line\n  // Only valid configurations reach this point\n  const session = createSession(...);\n  const file = openFile(...);\n  // ... rest of initialization\n}\n```\n\n**Pattern elements:**\n1. **Check location:** At the very top of the entry function, before any state changes\n2. **Condition check:** Extract values from input parameters, test for conflict\n3. **Error code:** Stable identifier starting with `E-`\n4. **Error message:** Multi-line explanation with:\n   - What requirement was violated\n   - Which specific condition is incompatible\n   - Why it's unsafe (technical explanation)\n   - Cross-references to analysis beads\n5. **Details object:** Raw diagnostic data for debugging\n\n### 3. Test Pattern\n\n```typescript\ndescribe('Conflict detection', () => {\n  it('should throw when [condition]', () => {\n    const meta = createValidMeta();\n    // Trigger the conflict\n    meta.flags = BeaconFlags.Compressed;\n\n    expect(() => encodeBeacon(meta)).toThrow(BeaconValidationError);\n    expect(() => encodeBeacon(meta)).toThrow('E-COMPRESSION-RESUME-CONFLICT');\n  });\n\n  it('should provide clear error message', () => {\n    const meta = createValidMeta();\n    meta.flags = BeaconFlags.Compressed;\n\n    try {\n      encodeBeacon(meta);\n      expect.fail('Should have thrown BeaconValidationError');\n    } catch (error) {\n      expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(BeaconValidationError);\n      if (error instanceof BeaconValidationError) {\n        expect(error.code).toBe('E-COMPRESSION-RESUME-CONFLICT');\n        expect(error.message).toContain('Compression cannot be enabled');\n        expect(error.message).toContain('bf-17s0');\n      }\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('should include conflict details in error', () => {\n    const meta = createValidMeta();\n    meta.flags = BeaconFlags.Compressed;\n\n    try {\n      encodeBeacon(meta);\n      expect.fail('Should have thrown BeaconValidationError');\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof BeaconValidationError) {\n        expect(error.details).toBeDefined();\n        expect(error.details.flags).toBe(BeaconFlags.Compressed);\n        expect(error.details.compressionEnabled).toBe(true);\n        expect(error.details.resumeDisabled).toBe(false);\n      }\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('should allow [valid configuration]', () => {\n    const meta = createValidMeta();\n    // Valid configuration - both flags set\n    meta.flags = BeaconFlags.Compressed | BeaconFlags.ResumeDisabled;\n\n    expect(() => encodeBeacon(meta)).not.toThrow();\n  });\n\n  it('should fail before any state changes', () => {\n    const meta = createValidMeta();\n    meta.flags = BeaconFlags.Compressed; // Conflict!\n\n    // Check happens immediately, no side effects\n    expect(() => encodeBeacon(meta)).toThrow(BeaconValidationError);\n\n    // Verify input object unchanged\n    expect(meta.flags).toBe(BeaconFlags.Compressed);\n  });\n});\n```\n\n**Test coverage requirements:**\n- ✅ Conflict condition throws the error\n- ✅ Error code matches expected value\n- ✅ Error message explains the incompatibility\n- ✅ Error details include diagnostic data\n- ✅ Valid configurations don't throw\n- ✅ Check happens before state changes\n- ✅ No side effects from the check itself\n\n## Error Code Convention\n\n### Format\n\n```\nE-[CATEGORY]-[SPECIFIC-CONDITION]\n```\n\n**Examples:**\n- `E-COMPRESSION-RESUME-CONFLICT` — Incompatible flag combination\n- `E-K-OVERFLOW` — Parameter exceeds maximum supported value\n- `E-QUOTA-PREFLIGHT` — Resource constraint violation\n\n### Registration\n\nWhen adding a new error code, register it in `src/core/errors/error-codes.ts`:\n\n```typescript\n// User-facing message\nexport const ERROR_MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {\n  // ... existing codes ...\n  'E-COMPRESSION-RESUME-CONFLICT': 'Compression cannot be enabled without disabling resume.',\n  // ... add new code here ...\n};\n\n// Metadata\nexport const ERROR_METADATA: Record<string, {\n  category: string;\n  recoverable: boolean;\n  severity: ErrorSeverity;\n}> = {\n  // ... existing codes ...\n  'E-COMPRESSION-RESUME-CONFLICT': {\n    category: 'protocol',\n    recoverable: false,        // User must fix and retry\n    severity: ErrorSeverity.FATAL,\n  },\n  // ... add new code here ...\n};\n```\n\n## Safety Properties\n\n### 1.
